title: Islamic Golden Age
subtitle: The 750–1258 band and the caliphate rows

waypoints.title: Abbasid, 750
waypoints.narrative: The Islamic Golden Age band runs from 750 to 1258. This stop sits on the Abbasid row, which the checklist starts in 750. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Al-Andalus, 750
waypoints.narrative: Al-Andalus is already current in 750, the start of the Islamic Golden Age band. The checklist row itself starts in 711. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Fatimid, 909
waypoints.narrative: The Fatimid checklist row starts in 909, inside the same band, and also lists 969. This stop uses 909. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Band end, 1258
waypoints.narrative: The band ends in 1258. The Ilkhanate checklist row, started in 1256, is still current. The stop uses the band’s end and does not add a list of sciences. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Mongol Empire, 1206
waypoints.narrative: The Mongol conquests band uses the Mongol Empire row, 1206 to 1368. This stop uses 1206. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Golden Horde, 1242
waypoints.narrative: The Golden Horde checklist row starts in 1242, inside that band. This stop uses that year. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Ilkhanate, 1256
waypoints.narrative: The Ilkhanate checklist row starts in 1256. This stop uses that year. The cited page was not opened.

waypoints.title: Yuan, 1271
waypoints.narrative: The Yuan checklist row starts in 1271, still inside the band. This stop uses that year. It does not add a conquest list. The cited page was not opened.
